name: S1Client::is_ready

test_list.description: The client performs the S1 version handshake and an authenticated Health RPC before reporting admission readiness.
A valid S1 Health response with ready=false is reported as not ready without claiming model readiness.
Missing, malformed, or major-incompatible protocol versions in Health are a protocol error.
The authenticated Health RPC is bounded by the client's configured timeout.

inputs.name: self
inputs.description: Authenticated client configured for one local S1 worker endpoint.

output_description: True only when the peer completes the S1 handshake and an authenticated, protocol-valid Health response reports service admission ready; false means admission is closed, not that a model is unloaded.
